positions.title: Digital Support Engineer
positions.companyDescription: Irish manufacturer of workwear, PPE and safety footwear, founded in 1904.
positions.companyDescription2: Sells internationally through its own e-commerce platform and a distributor network.
details: Designed and maintain a 104-model dbt project over Infor M3 ERP data (57 staging, 16 intermediate, 15 mart, 16 admin), with generic and custom tests.
Built the SQL views, Azure SQL Managed Instance structures and Python automation behind daily refreshes, incremental loads and large-scale exports.
Wrote the reference documentation for 149 M3 tables, separating vendor-defined field semantics from measured local usage so reports and models read each field the same way.

Built a Python MCP server giving AI tools read-only access to the M3 schema (six tools, 141 tables, 2,936 field definitions, self-test harness). Wrote six reusable agent skills and the API endpoints exposing M3 data to Copilot.
Trace data defects across the ERP, webshop, PIM and warehouse systems, and built a cron-health dashboard after finding scheduled jobs were failing silently.
Work with IT, Digital, Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to turn business requirements into tested, documented technical solutions.
Principal developer on the internal Laravel platform (217 classes, ~46% of commits), working through Git branches and pull requests, with an 88-file Pest test suite I introduced.
Found and fixed an unauthenticated SQL injection on a public endpoint, then audited access control across every report endpoint and added regression tests.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.companyDescription: Pitney Bowes is a US multinational founded in 1920.
positions.companyDescription2: Provides mailing, shipping and financial services to businesses worldwide.
details: Built a rerate tool in Python and SQL over Snowflake to recalculate client invoices across multiple pricing structures and data sources.
Wrote automated Python and SQL checks over Snowflake to detect invoice errors and validate refund calculations, cutting manual effort by over 50%.
Designed and maintained internal and client-facing Tableau and Power BI dashboards, including retention dashboards for Client Engagement and analysis that sped up claim adjudication.
Developed algorithms and reporting tools to streamline the Loss Prevention team's operations and inform risk assessment.
Automated workflows with Power Automate, Jira automation rules and Python, and worked across teams to find operational bottlenecks and deliver data-led fixes.
Pitney Bowes Recognition Award (2023–2024): multiple nominations for cross-functional collaboration and support.
The role ended in December 2024 with the closure of the Global E-commerce division.

Worked with IT on payment gateway API integrations to strengthen transaction security.
